summary: dellemc.openmanage iDRAC modules are compatible with ansible-core 2.19, most iDRAC modules and roles gained iDRAC10 support, and idrac_syslog is deprecated.
questions: Are OpenManage iDRAC modules compatible with ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage iDRAC10 support
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 12.0.0, the OpenManage iDRAC modules are compatible with **ansible-core 2.19**. Most iDRAC modules and roles (attributes, bios, boot, certificates, diagnostics, firmware, lifecycle controller, reset, secure boot, session, system info, user and more) are enhanced for **iDRAC10**. `idrac_syslog` is **deprecated**.
